text: {"title": "Domestic Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark - Scheme I)", "description": "The primary third-party quality assurance framework of BIS for domestic Indian manufacturers, licensing the use of the iconic ISI Standard Mark.", "applicability": "Applies to wide-ranging goods. text: {"title": "Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS - Scheme II)", "description": "A streamlined self-declaration framework primarily administered under order of MeitY for electronics, IT, and solar-energy hardware.", "applicability": "Mandatory for 77+ electronics and IT product categories (laptops, mobile phones, power banks, chargers, solar inverters, LED lights) with no factory inspections prior to registration.", "sla_days": "15 to 20 days", "procedures": {"flow": ["Step 1: Foreign/Domestic manufacturer registers on the CRS Online portal (crsbis.in).", "Step 2: Generates a test request for the selected product and standard.", "Step 3: Submits physical product samples to a BIS-recognized LIMS lab within 60 days of generating request.", "Step 4: Lab tests the product and uploads the digital test report on the portal.", "Step 5: Manufacturer fills the application form, links the test report, pays the registration fee, and submits.", "Step 6: If importing, foreign manufacturers nominate an Authorized Indian Representative (AIR).", "Step 7: BIS scrutinizes online documents and grants a registration R-Number."]}, "mandatory_documents": ["Trademark authorization or brand ownership certificate", "Valid lab test report (must be under 90 days old from a BIS recognized lab)", "Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) nomination and legally binding affidavit (for foreign entities)", "Business licence of manufacturing unit with English translation", "Undertaking regarding safety parameters of the models registered"], "active_registries": "26,949 active listings across 73 product groupings administered under 44 core specifications."}

text: {"title": "Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)", "description": "A specialized certification program running since the year 2000, enabling overseas manufacturers to mark their products with the ISI Mark for export to India.", "applicability": "Applicable for all product categories except Electronics & IT goods (which go to CRS).
